summary: An order restores maintenance work at {workplace} so the displaced crew has something left to bargain about.
realLife: The Board ordered Fibreboard to bring maintenance back, offer reinstatement and bargain. The record showed the contractor still did much the same work and the contract could be ended on notice.
gates: The case record identifies the remedial order, continuing maintenance need and termination provision.
inGame: needs: remedial order, continuing maintenance need and termination provision.

turns.what: The employer can offer former or equivalent positions.
The board examines the actual work and contract notice terms.
